cards.example_en: I usually do homework after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我通常晚饭后做作业。

cards.example_en: A quiet valley lies behind the hills near our town.
cards.example_zh: 我们镇附近的山后有一片安静的谷地。

cards.example_en: Time is a valuable thing for students.
cards.example_zh: 时间对学生来说是宝贵的东西。

cards.example_en: There is a small variation in temperature between the rooms.
cards.example_zh: 这几个房间之间的温度有一点小变化。

cards.example_en: The shop sells a wide variety of fruit.
cards.example_zh: 这家商店出售各种各样的水果。

cards.example_en: The shop sells various fruits from nearby farms.
cards.example_zh: 这家店出售附近农场的各种水果。

cards.example_en: Prices vary from shop to shop.
cards.example_zh: 各店价格不同。

cards.example_en: She put the flowers in a vase.
cards.example_zh: 她把花插进花瓶。

cards.example_en: We climbed the hills and saw a vast lake beyond them.
cards.example_zh: 我们爬上山丘，看见远处有一片很大的湖。

cards.example_en: No vehicle may enter the park during the festival.
cards.example_zh: 节日期间，任何车辆都不得进入公园。

cards.example_en: The concert venue is a hall near the railway station.
cards.example_zh: 音乐会的地点是火车站附近的一座大厅。

cards.example_en: I prefer the film version of that famous story.
cards.example_zh: 我更喜欢那个著名故事的电影版本。

cards.example_en: The victim of the theft described his missing phone.
cards.example_zh: 这起盗窃案的受害人描述了他丢失的手机。

cards.example_en: The film has no violence, so younger children can watch it.
cards.example_zh: 这部电影没有暴力，所以更小的孩子也可以看。

cards.example_en: The class met in a virtual classroom.
cards.example_zh: 这节课在虚拟教室里上。

cards.example_en: Patience is a virtue.
cards.example_zh: 耐心是一种美德。

cards.example_en: The mountain is visible from here.
cards.example_zh: 从这里能看见那座山。

cards.example_en: The coach's vision for the team included harder daily practice.
cards.example_zh: 教练对球队的眼光包括更刻苦的日常训练。

cards.example_en: A visitor from Canada stayed with our family last weekend.
cards.example_zh: 上周末，一位从加拿大来的来访者住在我们家。

cards.example_en: The visual guide helped me set up the new printer.
cards.example_zh: 这份图解帮我把新打印机装好了。

cards.example_en: Exercise is vital for health.
cards.example_zh: 锻炼对健康至关重要。

cards.example_en: She gave a vivid description of the trip.
cards.example_zh: 她生动地描述了那次旅行。

cards.example_en: Reading builds your vocabulary.
cards.example_zh: 阅读能增加词汇。

cards.example_en: The volcano has been quiet for years.
cards.example_zh: 这座火山已经安静了很多年。

cards.example_en: The baby woke up because the volume was too high.
cards.example_zh: 宝宝醒了，因为音量太大了。

cards.example_en: The job pays a fair wage.
cards.example_zh: 这份工作报酬公平。

cards.example_en: The water came up to his waist.
cards.example_zh: 水淹到了他的腰。

cards.example_en: Don't wander off during the visit.
cards.example_zh: 参观时不要走散。

cards.example_en: She works in the children's ward.
cards.example_zh: 她在儿童病房工作。

cards.example_en: A storm warning told us to stay indoors after lunch.
cards.example_zh: 一场暴风雨警报通知我们午饭后留在室内。

cards.example_en: The washroom is down the hall.
cards.example_zh: 洗手间在走廊那头。

cards.example_en: The museum keeps an old weapon inside a glass case.
cards.example_zh: 博物馆把一件古老的武器保存在玻璃柜里。

cards.example_en: My aunt's wedding will be in a garden this June.
cards.example_zh: 我阿姨的婚礼今年六月将在一座花园里举行。

cards.example_en: Pull the weed out of the garden.
cards.example_zh: 把花园里的杂草拔掉。

cards.example_en: We have a weekly test on Friday.
cards.example_zh: 我们每周五有一次小测。

cards.example_en: She began to weep at the sad ending.
cards.example_zh: 看到悲伤的结局她哭了起来。

cards.example_en: The club collects money for the welfare of stray dogs.
cards.example_zh: 俱乐部募钱，用来改善流浪狗的福利。

cards.example_en: We watched a western film about cowboys last night.
cards.example_zh: 昨晚我们看了一部讲牛仔的西部电影。

cards.example_en: Farmers grow wheat on this plain.
cards.example_zh: 农民在这片平原上种小麦。

cards.example_en: Please whisper in the library.
cards.example_zh: 在图书馆请小声说话。

cards.example_en: The problem is widespread.
cards.example_zh: 这个问题很普遍。

cards.example_en: The library has free Wi-Fi.
cards.example_zh: 图书馆有免费无线网。

cards.example_en: This shop sells wine and juice.
cards.example_zh: 这家店卖葡萄酒和果汁。

cards.example_en: Don't touch the broken wire.
cards.example_zh: 不要碰那根破电线。

cards.example_en: The story teaches a piece of wisdom.
cards.example_zh: 这个故事讲了一则智慧。

cards.example_en: The writer may withdraw the article before it is printed.
cards.example_zh: 作者可以在文章付印之前把它撤回。

cards.example_en: A witness told the police what happened near the shop.
cards.example_zh: 一位证人告诉警察商店附近发生了什么事。

cards.example_en: This scarf is made of soft wool from the farm.
cards.example_zh: 这条围巾是用农场出的柔软羊毛做的。

cards.example_en: The long trip was worthwhile.
cards.example_zh: 这次长途旅行值得。

cards.example_en: The cause is worthy of support.
cards.example_zh: 这项事业值得支持。

word.example_en: She entered by virtue of her high score.
The sign can give a warning.
word.example_zh: 这块牌子可以发出警告。
